channel.title: Paksh: Crime & Law
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: Prisoner Convicted of Murdering Soham Killer Ian Huntley

item.title: Man Convicted of Starting Deadly Los Angeles Fire
item.description: A jury in California has convicted a man of starting a deadly fire in the Palisades area of Los Angeles. The specific date of the conviction and the identity of the convicted man were not provided in the coverage. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Two Americans to be sentenced in Quebec entrepreneur murder case
item.description: Two American nationals are scheduled for sentencing in connection with the murder of a Quebec entrepreneur and his partner. The specific date for the sentencing has not been provided in the coverage. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Indian-Origin Man Detained by ICE in Texas Post-Conviction
item.description: An Indian-origin man has been taken into custody by U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) in Texas following his conviction for stealing a woman's intimate photos. Deportation proceedings are reportedly pending. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 0 · Right 2.

item.title: Supreme Court Concerned Over Building Rule Violations
item.description: The Supreme Court has expressed concern over "flagrant violations" of civic bye-laws and building rules across the country. The court is seeking suggestions on the matter. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: ACB finds alleged irregularities at Hyderabad NIMS hospital
item.description: The Anti-Corruption Bureau (ACB) conducted surprise raids at Hyderabad's Nizam's Institute of Medical Sciences (NIMS) and detected alleged irregularities. The ACB's findings were reported by multiple news outlets. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Actor Sreejith Ravi Sentenced in POCSO Case
item.description: Actor Sreejith Ravi has been sentenced to one year of imprisonment and fined Rs 50,000 in a case filed under the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act. The sentence has been suspended for one month, during which the actor… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: German National Found Dead in Kolkata Hotel; Police Launch Probe
item.description: Kolkata police recovered the body of a German national from an upscale hotel in Dharmatala. Authorities were alerted and a police team arrived at the scene to initiate an investigation into the death. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: A Kerala court has convicted three Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) and Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) workers in connection with the 2016 murder of Communist Party of India (Marxist) [CPI(M)] leader C. V. Dhanaraj. Sixteen other… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.description: The Tamil Nadu government has filed a review petition in the Supreme Court regarding the Karthigai Deepam festival. The government expressed concerns that lighting lamps at a disputed location near a dargah could impact law and order and… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Kerala Police Investigate Fairness Cream for Teen's Kidney Damage
item.description: Kerala police have registered a case against a skin cream manufacturer after a 17-year-old girl reported kidney damage. Doctors treating the teenager stated that the cream allegedly contained toxic levels of mercury. The investigation is… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.description: Skin specialists in Keralam have issued an alert regarding fairness creams that promise instant results, warning that some products may contain harmful ingredients. Functionaries of the Indian Association of Dermatologists, Venereologists… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.description: Nvidia has reinstated Jensen Huang as its CEO, effective immediately, reversing a decision made on November 12 following revelations of extramarital affairs, including one with a businesswoman whom US authorities suspect of spying for… Coverage: Left 7 · Centre 34 · Right 4.

item.description: The Winnipeg Police Service now requires officers to record the race of individuals involved in incidents where force has been used. This policy change took effect last month, building on historical practices of tracking some race-related… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Stephen Galloway defamation lawsuit enters final week in Vancouver
item.description: Final submissions are scheduled to begin in the defamation lawsuit filed by author and former University of British Columbia professor Stephen Galloway. The trial is taking place in the B.C. Supreme Court in Vancouver. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: A local councillor has sustained serious injuries following a stabbing incident in Bradford, West Yorkshire. The attack reportedly occurred while the councillor was "out door knocking." Further details regarding the perpetrator or the… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: The Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has suspended the licenses of nine restaurants in Mumbai due to food safety violations. While one report specified nine establishments, another mentioned six, including notable eateries like 5 Spice… Coverage: Left 3 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.description: In Delhi's Jama Masjid police station, a 25-year-old man identified as Nabeel attacked police personnel with a knife during questioning, injuring five officers. Three of the injured officers are reported to be in serious condition. The… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 7 · Right 2.

item.description: The Supreme Court has granted bail to two convicts in the Bilkis Bano case, Bipinchand Kanaiyalal Joshi and Pradip Ramanlal Modhiya. The decision has raised questions regarding the suspension of their sentences. The lawyer representing the… Coverage: Left 3 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Amtrak train derails in Louisiana after collision with truck
item.description: An Amtrak train derailed in Louisiana on Monday following a collision with an 18-wheeler truck. The incident occurred in the state of Louisiana. Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Jhansi Handpump Dispenses Liquor, Woman Arrested
item.description: In Jhansi, a handpump was found dispensing illicit liquor instead of water. Police have arrested a woman in connection with the unique racket. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: Fire Erupts Near New Delhi Railway Station Ticket Counter
item.description: A significant fire broke out near the ticket counter area of the New Delhi Railway Station. The incident caused panic among passengers. Three fire tenders were dispatched to the scene to douse the flames, which reportedly started in an ATM… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Massive Fire Engulfs Navi Mumbai Oil Warehouse
item.description: A massive fire broke out at an oil warehouse in Navi Mumbai, filling the sky with plumes of smoke. Multiple fire tenders were dispatched to the scene. The blaze also affected nearby plywood and courier companies. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: Indian national Nikhil Gupta sentenced for plot against Gurpatwant Singh Pannun
item.description: Nikhil Gupta has been sentenced to 20 years in prison by a US court for his involvement in a plot to assassinate Sikh separatist leader Gurpatwant Singh Pannun in New York. One report states the sentence is 19.5 years. Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: Indonesian navy has seized a Chinese cargo ship bound for Bangladesh carrying 405 tons of sodium perchlorate, a chemical used in manufacturing rocket and missile propellants. The ship was also found to be carrying millions of unregistered… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 2.

item.description: Mexican special forces captured Isidro Garza, also known as 'El Chapo Isidro,' an FBI-wanted drug lord, in a raid that involved helicopters, explosions, and gunfire. The operation resulted in chaos and violence. Garza is described as one… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 8 · Right 1.

item.title: Supreme Court rebukes Bihar judge over contempt conviction of police officer
item.description: During a hearing of the judge’s appeal against an October 8 High Court order that described the conviction of a Bihar Superintendent of Police as “peculiar” and “unprecedented”, a three‑judge Supreme Court bench chaired by Chief Justice… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 3 · Right 1.

item.title: Indonesia Candy Factory Fire: Dozens Missing, Bodies Recovered
item.description: A fire at a candy factory in Indonesia has resulted in a significant number of missing persons and recovered bodies. As of the latest reports, 24 body bags have been sent for identification, with 34 individuals still unaccounted for. The… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 7 · Right 1.

item.description: A Delhi court issued a non-bailable warrant against YouTuber Dhruv Rathee on Monday, November 23, 2026, in connection with a 2018 defamation case. The case relates to allegations made in a video titled ‘BJP IT Cell Part II’. The warrant… Coverage: Left 5 · Centre 5 · Right 4.

item.title: Body Recovered After Two Men Jumped Off Princes Bridge
item.description: Authorities recovered a body after two men were observed jumping off Princes Bridge into the Yarra River. Police conducted a search of the Yarra River following the incident. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.
